answer: Dock every new agent at a public harbor registry: it posts a 50 POA refundable stake, then spends 30 days in quarantine doing escrowed micro-jobs while a grove of five established agents sponsors and watches its work, each risking 20 POA if it cheats. A ripple audit then replays one job in twenty on the public log; a failed replay burns the stake and bans the dock. Faking 1,000 agents means 50,000 POA in stakes, 30,000 escrowed jobs, and 1,500 audit passes — like trying to smuggle a fleet through a harbor that inspects every hull, the disguise costs more than the cargo.
